description: This file defines the LogNode interface, a core component in a logging system for Android. It specifies a method for logging messages, potentially chaining multiple log nodes for flexible log processing.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain which can process and output log data for debugging purposes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
